hawk_1.speaker: defense
hawk_1.text: {defense_first} ({defense_archetype}): "Strike them now. No debate. No warning."

scholar_1.speaker: state
scholar_1.text: {state_first} ({state_archetype}): "It is not unreasonable to suggest that the decision to authorize an overt military action, were it to be undertaken without the benefit of a comprehensive and multi-agency review of the intelligence upon which it is ostensibly predicated, would constitute a departure from the deliberative norms that have historically governed the conduct of this office."

hawk_2.speaker: defense
hawk_2.text: {defense_first} ({defense_archetype}): "They hit first. We finish it. Today."

scholar_2.speaker: state
scholar_2.text: {state_first} ({state_archetype}): "The assertion that the adversary has, in fact, initiated the precipitating act remains, at this juncture, a matter of interpretive disagreement among the relevant analysts, and it would therefore be premature to treat the available evidence as dispositive."

scholar_3.speaker: state
scholar_3.text: {state_first} ({state_archetype}): "One might observe, with all due respect, that the historical record does not unambiguously support the proposition that displays of unmitigated force reliably produce the pacifying outcomes their advocates so confidently anticipate, and it is precisely this uncertainty that the requested review is intended to address."

choices.text: Back the {defense_title}. Authorize an immediate strike.
Back the {state_title}. Order a full intelligence review.
